.. _X_115:

X_115
=====

.. rubric:: CENTER OF KIEPERT HYPERBOLA

.. enunciation::

   :ref:`X_115 <X_115>` is the :g:`QA <[ Q A ]>`-:g:`P_{2} <P_2>` center (Euler-Poncelet Point) of quadrangle :g:`ABC << A B C >>`\ :ref:`X_2 <X_2>` (see http://www.chrisvantienhoven.nl/quadrangle-objects/10-mathematics/quadrangle-objects/12-qa-p2.html)

.. figure:: x-00115.svg
   :alt: X_115 — CENTER OF KIEPERT HYPERBOLA
   :align: center

   **X_115** (*CENTER OF KIEPERT HYPERBOLA*) constructed on acute reference triangle :math:`(a, b, c) = (5, 6, 7)` with unit baseline :g:`AB <[ A B ]>` = :math:`1`.

.. admonition:: Constructed Elements
   :class: note

   * **Circle:** :term:`Nine-Point Circle <nine-point circle>` (:g:`nine_point_circle <nine_point_circle>`) — Passes through side midpoints M_a, M_b, M_c and altitude feet H_a, H_b, H_c; centered at X_5
   * **Related Centers:** :g:`X_5 <X_5>` (:ref:`NINE-POINT CENTER <X_5>`)

.. signature:: center

   | **Trilinears:** :math:`bc(b^{2} - c^{2})^{2} : ca(c^{2} - a^{2})^{2} : ab(a^{2} - b^{2})^{2}`
   | **Barycentrics:** :math:`(b^{2} - c^{2})^{2} : (c^{2} - a^{2})^{2} : (a^{2} - b^{2})^{2}`
   | **Search Value (6, 9, 13):** :math:`2.224688461909`

.. collapse:: Alternate Coordinates
   :badge: 4 forms

   * **Trilinears:** :math:`\cos A - 2 \cos(B - C) + \cot \omega \sin A : :` (Peter J. C. Moses, 9/12/03)
   * **Trilinears:** :math:`\sin A \sin^{2}(B - C) : :`
   * **Barycentrics:** :math:`(S_{B} - S_{C})^{2} : :`
   * **Barycentrics:** :math:`(S_{A} - S_{\omega}) (S_{B} + S_{C}) + 4 S_{B} S_{C} : :`

   :badge: 2 combinations

Notes
-----

.. container:: note-item

   The circumcircle of the :term:`incentral triangle <incentral-triangle>` intersects the nine-point circle at 2 points, :ref:`X_11 <X_11>` and :ref:`X_115 <X_115>`, and :ref:`X_115 <X_115>` lies on the incentral circle and the cevian circle of every point on the Kiepert hyperbola. Let :g:`A'B'C' << H_a H_b H_c >>` be the orthic triangle. The Brocard axes of :g:`AB'C' << A H_b H_c >>`, :g:`BC'A' << B H_c H_a >>`, :g:`CA'B' << C H_a H_b >>` concur in :ref:`X_115 <X_115>`. Let :g:`P <P>` be a point on the Brocard circle, and let :g:`L <L>` be the line tangent to the Brocard circle at P. Let :g:`P' <P'>` be the trilinear pole of :g:`L <L>`, and let :g:`P″ <P″>` be the isotomic conjugate of :g:`P' <P'>`. As P varies, :g:`P″ <P″>` traces an ellipse with center at :ref:`X_115 <X_115>`. (Randy Hutson, July 23, 2015)

.. container:: note-item

   Let :g:`L_{a} <L_a>`, :g:`L_{b} <L_b>`, :g:`L_{c} <L_c>` be the lines through :g:`A <A>`, :g:`B <B>`, :g:`C <C>`, resp. parallel to the Brocard axis. Let :g:`M_{a} <M_a>`, :g:`M_{b} <M_b>`, :g:`M_{c} <M_c>` be the reflections of :g:`BC <[ B C ]>`, :g:`CA <[ C A ]>`, :g:`AB <[ A B ]>` in :g:`L_{a} <L_a>`, :g:`L_{b} <L_b>`, :g:`L_{c} <L_c>`, resp. Let :g:`A' <A'>` = :g:`M_{b} <M_b>`\ ∩\ :g:`M_{c} <M_c>`, and define :g:`B' <B'>`, :g:`C' <C'>` cyclically. Triangle :g:`A'B'C' << A' B' C' >>` is inversely similar to, and 3 times the size of, :g:`ABC << A B C >>`. Let :g:`A″B″C″ << A″ B″ C″ >>` be the reflection of :g:`A'B'C' << A' B' C' >>` in the Brocard axis. The triangle :g:`A″B″C″ << A″ B″ C″ >>` is homothetic to :g:`ABC << A B C >>`, with center of homothety :ref:`X_115 <X_115>`; see :cite:`Hyacinthos #16741 <hyacinthos>`/16782, Sep 2008.

.. container:: note-item

   Let :g:`F <F>` be the Feuerbach point, :ref:`X_11 <X_11>`, and :g:`F_{a}F_{b}F_{c} << F_a F_b F_c >>` be the Feuerbach triangle (the extraversion triangle of :ref:`X_11 <X_11>`). Let :g:`A' <A'>` be the barycentric product F\*\ :g:`F_{a} <F_a>`, and define :g:`B' <B'>`, :g:`C' <C'>` cyclically. The lines :g:`AA' <[ A A' ]>`, :g:`BB' <[ B B' ]>`, :g:`CC' <[ C C' ]>` concur in :ref:`X_115 <X_115>`. (Randy Hutson, January 29, 2018)

.. container:: note-item

   **Roland H. Eddy and R. Fritsch,** "The conics of Ludwig Kiepert: a comprehensive lesson in the geometry of the triangle," *Mathematics Magazine* 67 (1994) 188-205.

.. container:: note-item

   For a construction of :ref:`X_115 <X_115>` as intersection point of four conics see :person:`Peter Moses <peter-moses>`, `euclid 5328 <https://groups.io/g/euclid/message/5328>`__.

.. container:: note-item

   For an artistic design generated by :ref:`X_115 <X_115>`, see :ref:`X_244 <X_244>`.

.. container:: note-item

   p> :ref:`X_115 <X_115>` = midpoint of X_i and X_j for these {i,j}: {1, 13178}, {2, 671}, {3, 6321}, {4, 98}, {6, 11646}, {8, 7983}, {10, 11599}, {13, 14}, {15, 23004}, {16, 23005}, {17, 11602}, {18, 11603}, {20, 10723}, {69, 10754}, {76, 1916}, {83, 11606}, {99, 148}, {100, 10769}, {125, 16278}, {226, 11608}, {265, 18332}, {316, 385}, {321, 11611}, {381, 11632}, {625, 32457}, {805, 31513}, {1131, 6568}, {1132, 6569}, {1650, 13179}, {1992, 11161}, {2009, 2010}, {2394, 14223}, {2679, 6071}, {2996, 8781}, {3448, 15342}, {3830, 14830}, {4052, 34899}, {5466, 9180}, {5469, 5470}, {5485, 5503}, {5912, 34169}, {6033, 12188}, {6054, 12243}, {6055, 9880}, {6108, 31710}, {6109, 31709}, {6772, 6775}, {6777, 6778}, {6779, 25156}, {6780, 25166}, {6782, 33517}, {6783, 33518}, {7809, 19570}, {7840, 11054}, {8029, 14443}, {8352, 22329}, {8587, 17503}, {9114, 22578}, {9116, 22577}, {9140, 9144}, {9293, 13187}, {9302, 14492}, {9862, 10722}, {10153, 32532}, {10418, 14832}, {11005, 22265}, {12042, 22515}, {13173, 13180}, {13181, 22514}, {14041, 14568}, {14639, 14651}, {16001, 25560}, {16002, 25559}, {19905, 20423}, {22512, 22513}, {24345, 24711}
